paragraphs: I'm applying for the Capital Markets Specialist I role in Affirm's 2027 Early Career Program. I'm finishing an MBA in Finance (STEM) at Fordham Gabelli in Spring 2027, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. What draws me to this team is how directly it is tied to the business: the ABS, forward flow and warehouse funding you raise is what pays for Affirm's originations.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst building forecasts and scenario models that improved capital efficiency by 15%. At Thomson Reuters I ran cash flow analysis covering more than 80% of total inflows and helped cut the cash conversion cycle by 20%. In my MBA I built a DCF and an LBO model for J.M. Smucker, and in a project finance case I compared senior debt, green loan and ABS structures for a solar portfolio.

That maps well to the day-to-day here: keeping funding operations accurate, modeling structures carefully, and working with credit, product and engineering so the capital platform keeps up with growth. I'd like to grow into transaction work over time, and I'd welcome the chance to talk.
